New approaches to asylum and integration in the EU: Denmark's migration makeover

Briefing 09-09-2026

Although originally a country with a liberal approach to migration, Denmark has gradually introduced stricter asylum policies, until returning migrants – rather than integrating them – became the priority. This was in part a reaction to migrants increasing as a share of the population, and the wish to maintain Denmark's generous welfare system.

Implementation into Union law of measures adopted by regional fisheries management organisations

At a Glance 09-09-2026

The European Union (EU), as a contracting party to several regional fisheries management organisations (RFMOs), is obliged to implement these organisations' decisions into EU law. During the September 2026 plenary session, the European Parliament is due to vote on the agreement resulting from interinstitutional negotiations with the Council of the EU on measures adopted by six RFMOs. The new measures would be implemented through amendments to existing EU legislation.
